name: God Creating The World
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, having made the heavens, the earth, and all that is within them by His divine will and power. From the opening declaration in Genesis that God created the heavens and the earth, to the affirmation in John and Colossians that all things were made through and for Christ, the Bible emphasizes God's intentional and authoritative act of creation. Isaiah underscores God's personal involvement in stretching out the heavens and commanding all their host, while Romans highlights how creation itself testifies to God's eternal power and divine nature. Together, these verses affirm the foundational truth that God alone is the origin and sustainer of all that exists.
